title.en: Tale 10 — The Fox and the Drum

sentences.ar: ثعلب جعان كان يمشي جنب شجرة.
sentences.en: A hungry fox was walking beside a tree.

sentences.ar: الريح كانت تحرك غصن على طبل قديم.
sentences.en: The wind was moving a branch against an old drum.
The sound was loud and frightening.

sentences.ar: قال الثعلب: هاد إشي كبير، أكيد فيه لحم كتير.
sentences.en: The fox said: this is something big, surely there is much meat in it.
He came near and opened the drum with his teeth.

sentences.ar: أكبر صوت بيطلع من أفرغ إشي.
sentences.en: The biggest noise comes out of the emptiest thing.
